description: This source file defines the TransactionService class, which provides CRUD operations for transaction data by interfacing with an API client. It contains methods to list, create, update, and remove transactions, utilizing JSON serialization/deserialization with TransactionModel objects.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: A service class for handling CRUD operations related to transactions via an API client.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a list of transactions, optionally filtered by month.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction identified by ID.
